newsitem.title: BOSNIA: 31 injured in Sarajevo tram fire.
newsitem.headline: 31 injured in Sarajevo tram fire.

text.p: Thirty one people were injured in Sarajevo on Tuesday when a tram caught fire during the morning rush-hour, Bosnian radio said.
A city transport official said passengers who smashed windows to escape were treated for smoke inhalation and shock after the blaze, thought to have been caused by a short circuit.

Sarajevo lost dozens of trams during the 3-1/2 year Bosnian war and the city transport company is struggling to upgrade the transport system. It often has to resort to patching up old trams instead of buying new ones.
